AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:displayDescription: On-device spending insights, payment search, and approved journal updates.
AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: Kanakku exposes opt-in spending summaries, analytics, transaction search, recurring-pattern results, and limited journal changes while the journal is unlocked. Operational Patterns: Search with searchTransactions to obtain a transactionId before calling updateTransaction. A createManualExpense result with status possible_match contains likely existing payments; resolve the user's choice before retrying, and use createSeparate=true only if they choose a separate expense. A queued write is not saved until Kanakku reports completion. Constraints: Existing note text is searched on-device but never returned. Search results include transaction IDs and requested payment details. Recurring results are inferred patterns, not active mandates. Manual-expense matching uses an amount difference of up to ₹1 and a date difference of up to seven days, with merchant matching when supplied. Updates are limited to merchant, category, note, and a recurring decision; deletions and destructive changes are unavailable. Journal writes require Gemini access and an unlocked journal, and may require in-app approval according to the user's setting.
